vehicles.label: Jeep Cherokee XJ
vehicles.description: AMC/Chrysler unibody SUV. Solid front axle, coil/leaf, 4.0L straight-six. The classic build platform.

vehicles.label: Jeep Wrangler Unlimited LJ
vehicles.description: The long-wheelbase TJ Unlimited (2004–2006). 103.5-inch wheelbase, 4.0L I6 only, Dana 30 front / Dana 44 rear standard (Dana 44 front on the 2005–06 Rubicon). Coil-sprung solid axles. The cult-favorite Wrangler — TJ articulation with a usable wheelbase and bed-length cargo room.

vehicles.label: Jeep Wrangler YJ
vehicles.description: Square-headlight Wrangler. AMC-era leaf-sprung Wrangler with the 4.0L straight-six (1991-1995), 4.2L 258 I6 (1987-1990), or 2.5L AMC four. Solid Dana 30 front and Dana 35 (mostly) rear. Foundation for the modern Wrangler lineage.

vehicles.label: Jeep Wrangler JK
vehicles.description: JK Wrangler (2007–2018). Coil-sprung solid axles front and rear, body-on-frame, 3.8L V6 (2007–2011) or 3.6L Pentastar (2012–2018). Two- and four-door variants. Mid-cycle refresh in 2011 introduced LIN-bus steering wheel switches.

vehicles.label: Jeep CJ-5
vehicles.description: Long-production CJ — Buick 225 Dauntless V6 (1965-1971), AMC 232/258 inline-six, or AMC 304 V8 in later years. Short 83.5-inch wheelbase, leaf-sprung front and rear, Dana 27 or Dana 30 front, Dana 44 rear on most. No factory roll cage — modern roll protection is a build, not an option.

vehicles.label: Jeep CJ-7
vehicles.description: Long-wheelbase CJ at 93.5 inches. AMC 232/258 inline-six or AMC 304 V8, T-150/T-176/T-4/T-5/SR-4 manuals, Dana 30 front, AMC 20 rear with the infamous two-piece axle shaft (or Dana 44 rear on rare Renegade builds). Direct ancestor of the YJ Wrangler. More usable than a CJ-5, more aftermarket support than anything older.

vehicles.label: Jeep Grand Cherokee ZJ
vehicles.description: First-generation Grand Cherokee. Unibody with Quadra-Coil suspension front and rear, solid Dana 30 front, Chrysler 8.25 or Dana 44a rear, 4.0L straight-six or 5.2/5.9L Magnum V8. Sleeper trail rig with real off-road bones — and real rust problems if you live where roads see salt.

vehicles.label: Jeep Grand Cherokee WJ
vehicles.description: Second-generation Grand Cherokee. Solid axles front and rear, Quadra-Coil suspension, Quadra-Drive on top trims. 4.0L straight-six or 4.7L PowerTech V8 (HO version added 2002). Trail-capable as delivered — the last real Grand Cherokee for serious off-road work.

vehicles.label: Jeep Grand Cherokee WK
vehicles.description: Third-generation Grand Cherokee — the controversial IFS pivot. Independent front suspension replaces the WJ's solid axle. 3.7L V6, 4.7L V8, 5.7L Hemi, or 3.0L CRD diesel. SRT8 6.1L variant exists. Quadra-Drive II available on top trims.

vehicles.label: Nissan Pathfinder
vehicles.description: Three body-on-frame generations (WD21, R50, R51) before the 2013 unibody pivot. R51 with the VQ40DE V6 is the off-road sweet spot.

vehicles.label: Ford Bronco II
vehicles.description: Compact Ranger-based SUV. TTB Dana 28/35 front axle. 2.8L Cologne V6 (1984), 2.9L Cologne V6 (1986-1990), 4.0L OHV (1990). Underrated budget trail platform with a real rollover history that needs honest discussion.

vehicles.label: Ford Full-Size Bronco
vehicles.description: Five generations of full-size Bronco on the F-150 chassis. 5.0L / 5.8L Windsor V8, 351M, and 460 big-block options. TTB Dana 44 from 1980, solid front 1978-79. Removable hardtop on every year.

vehicles.label: Ford Bronco (6th Gen)
vehicles.description: Modern Bronco. 2.3L EcoBoost four, 2.7L EcoBoost V6, or Raptor 3.0L. HOSS suspension, removable doors and top, Sasquatch package with 35s and factory lockers. Badlands trim adds electronic sway-bar disconnect and an HD frame.

vehicles.label: Ford Bronco (Early)
vehicles.description: First-gen Ford Bronco. Dana 44 front and rear, body-on-frame, I6 or V8. High-dollar collector and capable build platform.

vehicles.label: Ford F-150 Raptor
vehicles.description: High-speed desert truck built on the F-150 platform. Long-travel Fox shocks, EcoBoost twin-turbo V6, beadlock-capable 17s. Built for whoops and washes, not rocks.

vehicles.label: Ram Power Wagon
vehicles.description: Heavy-duty 3/4-ton with factory locking diffs front and rear, electronic sway bar disconnect, Articulink suspension, and a Warn winch. The only factory-rock-ready full-size truck.

vehicles.label: Jeep Gladiator JT
vehicles.description: Wrangler-based midsize pickup. Solid Dana 44 axles front and rear, removable top and doors, 7,650-lb tow rating. The only modern open-top truck with factory lockers.
